description.text: The King's Reward Pack (王者奖赏包) of Battle Party: Dream Together is a one-card prize for the winner of a battle party: each box of part one (28 February 2025) and part two (18 April 2025) held one, and at the Battle Party: Dream Together shop events it went to the top player. Its 24 holo cards all carry the Battle Party: Dream Together (对战派对 共梦) logo. They include Venusaur ex, Charizard ex, Blastoise ex, Miraidon ex, Koraidon ex and Gardevoir ex, Radiant Charizard and Radiant Gardevoir, Trainers such as Rare Candy, Professor's Research and Boss's Orders, Fusion Strike Energy and basic Energy. They are numbered out of 24.
